behaviour: Cooked meat from the head of a pig, set in its own jelly and sold cold. It is cut in thin slices and eaten with a sharp dressing, never heated for long. The snout, museau, is sold and sliced the same way but is another cut.

contains.basis: Brawn is set in the jelly of the pig, which comes from animal bones and skin.
It is often kept in vinegar, which keeps a trace of the alcohol it is made from.
Cooked meats are often made with a stock or an extract that holds celery.
Cooked meats are sometimes made with lactose or milk protein.
Cooked meats are often kept with sulphites.
